w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 5 raiders (The Redactor, Inspiration, tick, The Paparazzo, Inspiration) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! No walls. No warning but the noise.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🕯️ Word comes back with a torn pack and no Sam. Gavel, out past the ridge. The fire is quieter tonight.

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Focus Group.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Chorus Line is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 Night. The lingering The Callback gorges at the treeline — 800 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 5 raiders (Judge Hoot, Loud-Eyes, The Loud Beast, Ugly-Eyes, Ad Break) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! No walls. No warning but the noise.

w5Mentions.name: The Cancellation
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Cancellation.
firstContext: "IN A WORLD..." begins the voiceover. It's talking about you.
Travel 1 tile to creek.
Something moves out there — The Cancellation.
👁️ Sanne freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
Butchering yields: 1 hide.

w5Mentions.name: The Editor
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Editor.
firstContext: You turn to leave — behind you, The Spoiler stirs.
Travel 1 tile to creek.
Something moves out there — The Editor.
👁️ Sanne freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
📓 Codex: Valeria picked up Cartographer's Eye from talking with you — what it does, and what it might go with.

w5Mentions.name: The Spoiler
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Spoiler.
firstContext: 💛 You hold Photo Album. Faces from before. Kalina's wedding. Your dad asleep in the chair. The neighbor's kid with the missing tooth. The most valuable thing you own, and it weighs nothing. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they know your hands. The feast was the weapon.
Travel 1 tile to creek.
Something moves out there — The Spoiler.
👁️ Sanne freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
💬 Zoe: "Huh. Never been this way before."

w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: ◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT."
◈ ABILITY — Dreadfield: The room feels you before you speak. Alien-terror starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ ABILITY — Oathbound: Your terror is pledged as a shield: your own people's horror grows half as fast.
◈ ABILITY — Shieldbearer: Spend terror to calm horror — the shield, not the sword. (Offered in the final beat.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: Riders on the ridge — no, a cart. A TRADER. Word travels: Haven has food, and where there's food there's trade.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
📺 SYSTEM: "TONIGHT: The Talent Pit. Talent show, judged by beings who have never seen talent. Applause is measured in decibels and confusion."
📺 SYSTEM: "Tonight's spectacle is presented by the Meridian Court. Beauty is mandatory. Applause will be measured."

firstContext: 🍖 FEAST 📺 — Paisley opens the pantry wide: 6× Foraged food, 1× Expedition haul, 1× Foraged food. Zoe, Benoit eat until the fire burns low. Nobody says what this cost — everybody knows, and winter is listening. For one evening, the pantry is lighter and the people are not. (−1,646 kcal from the pan
🍖 FEASTED ×2.53 until tomorrow's dawn (6 parts left): a proper feast. A channeled keepsake feeds the flames (devotion ×1.5). Arc IV burns hotter. Strikes and abilities hit with the feast behind them.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A full seat. global standing, every wave faced, the deeds complete. The table rises when you enter. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 4 · Forage 61 → 24 · capped · Craft 16 · Talk 12 · Explore 51 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Valeria Quispe ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

It wants the job itself: caretaking, as a practice. This is the ask the whole ladder was climbing toward.
